manual_all_steps: Open RU/ui.txt from the Project tree.
Edit UI_HELLO in the table or detail editor and confirm the row becomes dirty.
Use General -> Save. If a save/write prompt appears, choose Write to file for this scenario and record the prompt wording in Notes. Then open RU/menu.txt from the Project tree.
Switch back to RU/ui.txt and verify the saved value persists.
manual_checked_expected_checks: No startup or save error dialogs appear.
Dirty and clean state changes follow edit then save.
File switching does not break the saved value or active editing context.

scenario.goal: Verify the ordinary open/edit/save flow on a locale-diverse manual fixture without relying on fake file-close semantics.
operator_hints: This scenario verifies writing the copied fixture to disk, not cache-only save.
If Save prompts for a write or cache decision, choose Write to file and record the exact prompt wording in Notes. If no prompt appears, record that too.
scenario.start_context: Launch the scenario project with RU selected. This is a file-write scenario. Use Project tree file switching because the app does not expose a close-file action.
